correctness.rationale: Lagrange interpolation formulas yield w_a=(bc+1/3)/[(a-b)(a-c)] etc, and for ordered a<b<c positivity is equivalent to a=-s in (-1,-1/3), c>1/(3s), and -1/(3c)<b<1/(3s). Integrating ordered-node density 3/4 gives P(E)=log 3/2-1/3. Positivity imposes outer gap c-a>=2/sqrt(3); only two reflected adjacent collision faces can make ||V^{-1}||_F diverge. At left face b=a+h and c in a strip of width h/(3s²)+O(h²), h²||V^{-1}||_F² -> C(s)²=2(9s^4+4s²+1)/(3s²+1)². The two disjoint collision tubes and dominated convergence yield K=(1/4)int_{1/3}^1 C(s)²/s² ds=1-pi*sqrt(3)/36. Uniform outer-gap domination justifies exhaustion, and layer cake gives moment iff p<2. Independent exact positivity/inverse checks, near-collision calculations for three values of s, and symbolic integral re-evaluation corroborated the proof.

final_claim: For three iid uniform [-1,1] nodes, conditioned on strictly positive weights of the unique degree-two interpolatory quadrature rule with moments (1,0,1/3), P(E)=log(3)/2-1/3 and P(E,||V^{-1}||_F>T)~(1-pi*sqrt(3)/36)/T². Consequently conditioned tail has exact coefficient K/P(E), and finite positive moments exactly for p<2.
